|descr= Create an infobox for a Workbench Editor plugin.{{Feature|informative|All parameters are named.}}
Its error category is {{Link|Category:Infobox/WorkbenchPlugin template usage error|Infobox/WorkbenchPlugin template usage error}}.
|param1= name=
|descr1= the plugin's display name
|param2= editor=
|descr2= in which editors can this plugin be found - can be a multiple space-separated (case-insensitive) selection of:
<div style="margin-left: 2em">
{{Columns|4|
* {{Link|Arma Reforger:Resource Manager|resource}}
* {{Link|Arma Reforger:World Editor|world}}
* {{Link|Arma Reforger:Particle Editor|particle}}
* {{Link|Arma Reforger:Animation Editor|animation}}
* {{Link|Arma Reforger:Script Editor|script}}
* {{Link|Arma Reforger:Audio Editor|audio}}
* {{Link|Arma Reforger:Behavior Editor|behavior}}
* {{Link|Arma Reforger:String Editor|string}}
* {{Link|Arma Reforger:Procedural Animation Editor|procanim}}
}}
</div>
|param3= descr=
|descr3= a short description of the plugin's role(s)
|param4= uiPath=
|descr4= (Optional) UI path that will be prefixed by {{hl|Plugins/}}, e.g "Terrain" or "World/Prefabs" (will respectively display {{hl|Plugins/Terrain}} / {{hl|Plugins/World/Prefabs}})
|param5= shortcut=
|descr5= (Optional) keyboard shortcut - see {{Template|Controls}}
|param6= file=
|descr6= (Optional) the editor's file path - see {{Template|Link}}

|example1= <syntaxhighlight lang="handlebars">{{Infobox/WorkbenchPlugin}}</syntaxhighlight>
|result1= {{Infobox/WorkbenchPlugin}}

|example2= <syntaxhighlight lang="handlebars">
{{Infobox/WorkbenchPlugin
|name= My Plugin
|editor= script
|file=
}}
</syntaxhighlight>
|result2= {{Infobox/WorkbenchPlugin
|name= My Plugin
|editor= script
|file=
}}

|example3= <syntaxhighlight lang="handlebars">
{{Infobox/WorkbenchPlugin
|name= My Plugin
|editor= badvalue
|descr= plugin description
}}
</syntaxhighlight>
|result3= {{Infobox/WorkbenchPlugin
|name= My Plugin
|editor= badvalue
|descr= plugin description
}}

|example4= <syntaxhighlight lang="handlebars">
{{Infobox/WorkbenchPlugin
|name= My Plugin
|editor= bad value
|descr= plugin description
}}
</syntaxhighlight>
|result4= {{Infobox/WorkbenchPlugin
|name= My Plugin
|editor= bad value
|descr= plugin description
}}

|example5= <syntaxhighlight lang="handlebars">
{{Infobox/WorkbenchPlugin
|name= Basic Code Formatter
|editor= script
|descr= The Basic Code Formatter is a plugin that helps formatting code properly. Use is this way:
* Shortcut 1 to scan edited lines in the currently-opened file (or in a whole addon, depending on options)
* Shortcut 2 to scan '''all''' the lines in the currently-opened file (not depending on options)
|file= {{Link|enfusion://ScriptEditor/scripts/WorkbenchGame/ScriptEditor/SCR_BasicCodeFormatterPlugin.c}}
|shortcut= <nowiki/>
# {{Controls|Ctrl|Shift|K}}
# {{Controls|Ctrl|Alt|Shift|K}}
}}
</syntaxhighlight>
|result5= {{Infobox/WorkbenchPlugin
